from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.acquisition_online import get_asset_fetcher

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Fetch(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_fetch"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",       "string", widget_type="text", default="ensure_available")
        self.add_input("asset_id",     "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("provider",     "string", widget_type="text", default="megascans")
        self.add_input("environment",  "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("asset_list",   "any")
        self.add_input("download_url", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("dest_dir",     "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("quality",      "string", widget_type="text", default="medium")
        self.add_input("top_k",        "int",    widget_type="int",  default=10)
        self.add_output("local_path",  "string")
        self.add_output("source",      "string")
        self.add_output("results",     "list")
        self.add_output("result",      "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action      = str(inputs.get("action") or "ensure_available").strip().lower()
        asset_id    = str(inputs.get("asset_id") or "").strip()
        provider    = str(inputs.get("provider") or "megascans").strip()
        environment = str(inputs.get("environment") or "").strip()
        asset_list  = inputs.get("asset_list") or []
        download_url= str(inputs.get("download_url") or "").strip()
        dest_dir    = str(inputs.get("dest_dir") or "").strip()
        quality     = str(inputs.get("quality") or "medium").strip()
        top_k       = int(inputs.get("top_k") or 10)
        try:
            fetcher = get_asset_fetcher()
            if action == "fetch_environment":
                results = fetcher.fetch_environment_assets(environment, top_k=top_k, dest_dir=dest_dir, quality=quality)
                return {"local_path": "", "source": "multi", "results": [r.to_dict() for r in results], "result": {}, "exec_out": True}
            elif action == "fetch_assets":
                lst = asset_list if isinstance(asset_list, list) else []
                results = fetcher.fetch_assets(lst, dest_dir=dest_dir, quality=quality)
                return {"local_path": "", "source": "multi", "results": [r.to_dict() for r in results], "result": {}, "exec_out": True}
            elif action == "fetch":
                r = fetcher.fetch_asset(asset_id, provider=provider, download_url=download_url, dest_dir=dest_dir, quality=quality, force_download=True)
            else:
                r = fetcher.ensure_asset_available(asset_id, provider=provider)
            return {"local_path": r.local_path, "source": r.source, "results": [r.to_dict()], "result": r.to_dict(), "exec_out": True}
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_asset_fetch failed: {e}")
            return {"local_path": "", "source": "", "results": [], "result": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Fetch
